errors.text_span: LLaMA-2-7B scores ~67% with no SFT and ~83% with full SFT (D₀–D₂)
errors.evidence: Human reference states LLAMA-2-7B no SFT is approximately 66% and full SFT is close to 82%, but the machine description states 67% and 83% which are incorrect.
Reference states LLAMA-2-13B improves from around 70% to about 80%, but machine description reports fixed figures (70% to 80%) which do not align correctly.
Reference states LLAMA-2-70B rises from just above 80% to close to 80%, but machine description states 80% to 83%.
The description does not mention the vertical axis units (percentage) as clearly as the reference does.
The description omits mentioning the specific color patterns for the bars (stripes, solid fill) and their importance.
The chart purpose related to scaling and improvement in performance is mentioned but lacks detail on its implications on longer math word problems.
